start.speaker: Walter
start.content: See that pot there? Try planting something in it.

beanstalk.speaker: Walter
beanstalk.content: With a bit of luck, a beanstalk will emerge to whisk you away, right out of this dungeon!

choices.content: Why is there a flowerpot down here?

beanstalk_explain.speaker: Walter
beanstalk_explain.content: Aye! Sounds mad, I know, but hear me out. I wasn't always stuck down here. Before I got lost in this place, I was a gardener.

pot_question.speaker: Walter
pot_question.content: Ah, that's a long story. I wasn't always stuck down here, you know. Before I got lost in this place, I was a gardener.

gardener.speaker: Walter
gardener.content: Had a lovely little patch of land. Vegetables, herbs, flowers... even grew a pumpkin so large once I needed a wheelbarrow just to move the bloody thing.

choices.content: How does a gardener get lost in a dungeon?
So why are you still gardening down here?

mushrooms.speaker: Walter
mushrooms.content: They were supposed to be very good mushrooms.

why_garden.speaker: Walter
why_garden.content: Old habits, I suppose. Besides, this happens to be the only room in this miserable place where anything has a chance of growing.

searched.speaker: Walter
searched.content: Anyway, I've spent a long time wandering these halls since then. Long enough to learn something important.

no_exit.speaker: Walter
no_exit.content: There isn't a way out. Every passage leads deeper into the dungeon, ends in a wall, or somehow brings you right back where you started. Believe me, I've looked.

choices.content: There has to be another exit.

searched_everywhere.speaker: Walter
searched_everywhere.content: I thought the same thing. I've searched for one longer than you've been down here. Doors, tunnels, stairways... nothing leads to the surface.

not_quite.speaker: Walter
not_quite.content: Not quite. See that little crack in the ceiling?

sunlight.speaker: Walter
sunlight.content: Exactly! The only bit of sunlight I've seen anywhere in this miserable place. And where there's sunlight, there's a surface.

garden_reason.speaker: Walter
garden_reason.content: That's why I set up my little garden here. If anything has a chance of growing underground, it's in this room.

beanstalk_plan.speaker: Walter
beanstalk_plan.content: There's something strange about this dungeon. Plants behave differently down here. Give the right seed good soil, water and that little bit of sunlight...

beanstalk_growth.speaker: Walter
beanstalk_growth.content: ...and you might just grow a beanstalk big enough to reach all the way to the surface.

climb.speaker: Walter
climb.content: Straight to the surface. No doors. No tunnels. No secret passageways. Just you, that pot... and a great bloody beanstalk.

sure.speaker: Walter
sure.content: Sure? No. But I've searched every corner of this dungeon and I've never found another way to the surface.

only_way.speaker: Walter
only_way.content: As far as I can tell, that beanstalk is the only way out of this dungeon.

objective.speaker: Walter
objective.content: So find yourself a seed, plant it in that pot, and give it some water.

escape.speaker: Walter
escape.content: If everything goes according to plan, it'll grow straight through that crack and whisk you away... right back to the outside world.

good_luck.speaker: Walter
good_luck.content: Good! Keep your eyes open. There must be something growing somewhere in this dungeon that we can use.

doesnt_work.speaker: Walter
doesnt_work.content: Then I suppose you'll be helping me with the gardening.
